title: Path too long
cause: File path exceeds 260 characters on Windows
fix_summary: Shorten the path or enable long path support

title: Storage quota exceeded
fix_summary: Empty the web trash or add storage

title: File locked
cause: Another application has the file open
fix_summary: Close the application; sync resumes within 60 seconds

title: Unsupported characters
cause: File name has characters not allowed by the platform

title: Credentials rejected
fix_summary: Sign out and sign in again

title: NAT or firewall interference
cause: Strict NAT or SIP ALG on the router
fix_summary: Restart the router or switch to TLS 443

title: Device certificate expired
fix_summary: Select Renew certificate; managed devices need IT

title: Split DNS not applied
cause: Another VPN or DNS filter is interfering
fix_summary: Remove the other client and reconnect

title: Too many MFA attempts
cause: Repeated MFA requests; possible compromise if unexpected
fix_summary: Wait 15 minutes; reset password if requests were unexpected

title: SSD not detected
fix_summary: Request repair and do not reinstall Windows

title: Fan or thermal fault
fix_summary: Stop using the laptop and request repair
